'''Darth Vengean's flagship''' was a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] used as a [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] by the [[Dark Council]] member [[Darth Vengean]] until his death. In [[3642 BBY]], the ship, commanded by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Masken]], engaged a Republic cruiser commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Monk (Human)|Monk]] over [[Quesh]]. Monk was secretly a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for Vengean's apprentice, [[Darth Baras]], who in turn sent his own [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] to eliminate him. The apprentice boarded the flagship in search for Monk, where he learned from Masken and Monk and his men jettisoned to the surface of the planet.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Vengean's flagship appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Warrior class mission on Quesh.
